reader_summary.overview: Raphael Arndt is the CEO of the Future Fund. Raphael assumed the CEO seat in 2020 after serving as Chief Investment Officer for six years. Our conversation from five years ago about the Fund's total portfolio approach is replayed in the feed.

key_points.text: Raphael Arndt is the CEO of the Future Fund.
Our conversation focuses on the significant changes in the Future Fund over the last few years.
Raphael and his team spent a year analyzing changes in the global economy, demographics.
